description: React component for OWASP Risk Rating assessment, including risk calculation, vector parsing, and visualization with charts and select inputs.

methods.name: onVectorChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the OWASP vector input, validates and computes scores.

methods.name: validateVector
methods.description: Validates the OWASP vector string against a regex pattern.

methods.name: parseVector
methods.description: Parses the vector string into key-value pairs.

methods.name: computeLikehood
methods.description: Calculates the likelihood score based on selected factors.

methods.name: computeImpact
methods.description: Calculates the impact score based on selected factors.

methods.name: computeOverall
methods.description: Determines overall risk level from impact and likelihood.

methods.name: computeValues
methods.description: Computes impact, likelihood, and overall scores from vector fields.

methods.name: computeOwaspScores
methods.description: Main function to compute scores from vector string.

methods.name: updateSelectedValue
methods.description: Updates state for selected factor values.

methods.name: updateChart
methods.description: Updates chart data with new value.

methods.name: updateValues
methods.description: Updates vector string and scores based on user input.

methods.name: getCurrentValue
methods.description: Retrieves current selected option based on vector.
